notablePrerequisites: You control up to seven lands that can tap to produce at least {6}.
description:
Activate up to seven mana-producing lands by tapping them, adding at least {6}.
Cast Machine God's Effigy by paying {4}, choosing to have it enter the battlefield as a copy of Great Whale, except it's an artifact.
When Machine God's Effigy enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping up to seven lands you control.
Activate Machine God's Effigy by tapping it, adding {U}.
Activate Drafna's first ability by paying {1}{U}, returning Machine God's Effigy from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.
